goal: Unify Host profile selection for every agent role into agents.{profiles, presets, active} with an implicit default preset, keep legacy lanes configuration readable with deprecation diagnostics, and route Lane executor, Review and advisory consumers through one role resolver, per D1 of docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-DEC-2, BR-DEC-3, BR-DEC-9; meet D1 in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/agent-roles-config.test.ts and tests/layered-config.test.ts over resolveConfig and imm-kernel config --json. Done looks like: with the BR-DEC-3 fixture, imm-kernel config --json lists every role (executor, code-review, review-verifier, advisory-reviewer, judging, clarify, plan, repair) with host, model, effort, transport, preset and layer, following the lookup order active roles[r], default roles[r], active roles[*], default roles[*]. Negative: a preset naming an unknown profile reports unknown_profile; active naming a missing preset reports unknown_preset; a default preset without '*' reports preset_incomplete; review-verifier bound to a host other than code-review's reports review_verifier_host_mismatch; profiles or presets in the project file report config_invalid; each error falls the agents section back to legacy or built-in resolution. Bound: max_parallel 0 and 9 are rejected, 1 and 8 accepted.

Source BR-DEC-5; meet D1 legacy mapping in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/agent-roles-config.test.ts over resolveConfig. Done looks like: a user file with only lanes.profiles and lanes.active resolves executor, code-review and max_parallel to the same values as before plus a deprecated_config_source diagnostic. Negative: a layer holding both agents and lanes uses agents and reports legacy_source_ignored. Bound: with neither agents nor lanes every role resolves unset and Lane executor selection still falls back to the Parent Host.
